# Keep Calendar DOM IDs, localization IDs and persisted values distinct

The new Calendar range controls use dashed DOM IDs such as event-filter-all and dashed Fluent IDs such as calendar-event-listing-interval-all. Their value strings are the persisted filter choices. This existing family also contains older spellings such as P7D and next6Months. Proposed scoped naming rule: follow the DOM and Fluent namespaces for new controls, while preserving compatible stored values unless a migration is intentional. Do not turn one new lowercase value into a reason to rename all legacy choices.

Scope: Calendar filter naming.
